Daikin Park (formerly Minute Maid Park) Suite TypesAstros Executive Suite12 - 14 Tickets2 TicketsCatering AvailableAstros Party Suite14 - 125 TicketsCatering AvailableCoca-Cola Corner40 - 50 TicketsCatering AvailableDo You Own A Houston Astros Suite? 43% of suites go underused. Resell your suite for events you can't attend and maximize your ROI. Houston Astros Event Planning GuideCateringA Houston Astros luxury suite rental can be catered in advance to the game. Guests will pre-order from the Astros suite menu for an additional cost. On average, most people spend around $80-$100 per person for food and alcohol. There is no minimum and ordering ahead of time is optional.Parking and TransportationHouston Astros suite parking lots include the Diamond Lot, Lot A or Lot C. VIP parking passes included with your Astros suite rental will be clearly labeled with the matching lot. The rideshare pick-up and drop-off point is at the Center Field Gate. Not all suites include parking passes.BudgetHouston Astros luxury suites can cost between $5,000-$13,000 on average depending on the game. Astros suite rentals vary in cost based on the opponent, day of the week and suite location. In-suite catering should be budgeted as a separate cost and won't be due until the day of game.Dress CodeThere is no formal dress code for the Suite Level at Daikin Park (formerly Minute Maid Park). Corporate groups in an Astros luxury box typically wear business casual attire. However, it is not uncommon for suite guests to dress casually or in team branded apparel. Comfortable shoes are recommended.Venue Bag PolicyBackpacks, coolers, and bags larger than 16"x16"x8" are prohibited at the Astros ballpark, Daikin Park. That applies to all guests including anyone in a Houston Astros luxury suite. All bags, purses, and containers will be searched prior to entry. Minute Maid Park does NOT offer a bag-check option.EntrancesAstros suite ticket holders can use the VIP Entrance located near the Right Field Gate and take elevators directly to the Bank of America Suite Level. The Astros suite level opens 2 hours before to first pitch for games on Monday-Saturday. Gates will open 90 minutes prior to Sunday games.Child Ticket PolicyChildren 2 years of age and under do not require a separate ticket for admission. Any child older will need a ticket even if their group is in a Houston Astros luxury box. Astros suites can provide a safe, private space for groups entertaining with younger children.Club AccessThe Bank of America Suite Level at Daikin Park(formerly Minute Maid Park) features the finest amenities in the ballpark. The concourse area includes a newly renovated bar for suite ticket holders as well as Astros memorabilia in display cases along the perimeter of the Bank of America Suite Level.Business AmenitiesThe luxury suites at Daikin Park are the ideal setting to host your next business meeting or corporate event. Inside of your suite will be smart LED TV's and ample lounge area for socializing. Your suite attendant will cater to your every need so that you can focus on your employees and colleagues.Astros SpotlightCurrent MLB SeasonPosted 4/1/2026The Houston Astros remain one of the most consistently excellent franchises in all of baseball, and heading into the 2026 MLB season, the expectation in Houston is nothing less than a deep postseason run. Over the past several years, the Astros have cemented their legacy as a dynasty, capturing multiple American League pennants and continuing to field one of the most competitive and well-constructed rosters in the sport. Yordan Alvarez has established himself as one of the most feared hitters in the game, a left-handed masher whose combination of raw power and on-base ability makes him a nightmare for opposing pitchers from the moment he steps into the box. Jose Altuve, the heart and soul of this franchise for over a decade, continues to produce at an elite level while serving as the ultimate example of what an Astro is supposed to look and play like.
